duplicate_criterion: Same image or near-duplicate capture with essentially matching scene, pose, and framing. A shared subject, template, event, location, skyline, or blank/obscured appearance alone does not qualify.

method.note: Similarity annotations visible on contact sheets were not used as evidence of duplication. Only source pair identifiers were extracted from the neighbours JSON. U explicitly preserves uncertainty for sparse content.
